speaker: narrator
text: Mist rolls across the street and back. For one breath, you cannot see your own hands.

speaker: narrator
text: The mist comes in close and stops being weather. It knows where you have been.

speaker: narrator
text: The mist parts on a high window. A woman in white climbs onto the sill.

speaker: narrator
text: A table laid for two in an empty room. Wine poured for a guest who never came.

speaker: narrator
text: Two brothers fight in the fog below the castle. One takes the other's bright sword, and uses it.

speaker: narrator
text: In the fog a woman hums a lullaby. The tune climbs toward the castle stair.

speaker: narrator
text: An hour on the road out. Then the same milestone, the same shrine, the same crow.

speaker: narrator
text: A wedding climbs the hill in the mist. Pale women behind a veiled girl. There is no groom.

speaker: narrator
text: Three knocks. You raise what holy thing you carry, and the mist will not cross the sill.

speaker: narrator
text: The cold comes first. Then a hand in the mist, and teeth at your throat.

speaker: narrator
text: Violets on the sill where Lenka sleeps, still wet. She keeps one, and says nothing.

speaker: narrator
text: Frost creeps up Stefan's blade from the point. Its light goes thin.

speaker: narrator
text: Mist goes door to door through the parish. By morning, one more house stands dark.

speaker: narrator
text: He reaches for more than you can give, and stops. The cold takes your strength instead.

speaker: narrator
text: The Lantern flares. What he meant for you breaks on its light, and only the cold gets through.

speaker: count
text: Enough. Keep your day. I have others.

speaker: narrator
text: The mist draws back up the hill, and the cold goes with it. For today, he is gone.

speaker: narrator
text: Every lamp goes out at once. When they come back, Lenka's cloak lies empty on the floor.

speaker: count
text: She is home now. Come and ask her yourselves.

speaker: narrator
text: On the hill, one more window is lit. She can still be brought back. The hunt goes on.

speaker: narrator
text: The castle doors stand open, as if you were expected. Candles burn all the way up the stair.

speaker: narrator
text: Somewhere above, a table is being laid for guests.

speaker: narrator
text: The cards are read. For the first time since you came, you know where to go.

speaker: narrator
text: The blade and the Lantern are yours. On the hill, one lit window goes dark.

speaker: narrator
text: The Tome is read. You know what he wants now, and he knows that you know.

speaker: narrator
text: The mist thins at the parish edge, and the first seal breaks. His hold on Vellmoor slips.

speaker: narrator
text: A second seal cracks. Down in the valley, a church bell rings that has been silent since spring.

speaker: narrator
text: The third seal breaks. Nothing stands between you and his door now.
